title: Securities Trading Policy

tiers.name: Employees
tiers.description: All employees of the Group, including a Connected Person; may trade at any time subject to the insider trading prohibition, and need prior written clearance only to trade during a Prohibited Period or to engage in short-term trading.

tiers.name: Restricted Persons
tiers.description: Key Management Personnel (persons with authority and responsibility for planning, directing and controlling Company activities, including any director); Restricted Employees (senior management level or above, corporate/administrative role, exploration role, or Board-designated); key or senior contractors/consultants; and Connected Persons of KMP or a Restricted Employee. Must not trade in Company Securities at any time without first obtaining prior written clearance.

tiers.name: Key Management Personnel
tiers.description: Persons who have authority and responsibility for planning, directing and controlling the activities of the Company, directly or indirectly, including any director (executive or otherwise); a subset of Restricted Persons distinguished for Approving Officer routing.

tiers.name: Connected Persons
tiers.description: A spouse or partner, child or step-child under 18, a parent, an unlisted body corporate the person controls or is a director of, a trust of which the person is trustee and beneficiary, or any other person over whom the person has significant influence or control.

exceptions.approver: Approving Officer per the section 7 hierarchy
exceptions.evidence: A person may be in severe financial hardship if he or she has a pressing financial commitment that cannot be satisfied otherwise than by selling the relevant Company Securities.

exceptions.approver: Approving Officer per the section 7 hierarchy
exceptions.evidence: A circumstance may be considered exceptional if the person in question is required by a court order or a court enforceable undertaking to transfer or sell, or accept a transfer of, the Company Securities or there is some other overriding legal or regulatory requirement for him or her to do so.

exemption_authority: The Approving Officer (Managing Director, Chair, or Chair of the Audit Committee per the section 7 hierarchy) may grant written clearance to trade during a Prohibited Period for severe financial hardship or other circumstances deemed exceptional (including a court order or overriding legal requirement), with the exemption specifying the time period during which the sale can be made; the Board may separately exempt a person from the short-term trading ban in exceptional circumstances.

bespoke_clauses.clause: derivatives of any of the above (including equity swaps, futures, hedges and exchange-traded or over-the-counter options) whether settled by cash or otherwise
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A bank-written or purchased OTC put/call over Alkane shares is squarely within the policy's definition of Company Securities, so the hedging clearance requirement (section 10) applies directly rather than by analogy.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Restricted Persons are prohibited from entering into transactions or arrangements which limit the economic risk of participating in unvested entitlements under any equity based remuneration schemes.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A collar can only be entered once the relevant equity has vested; there is no clearance route for unvested entitlements.

bespoke_clauses.clause: it is not permissible to provide the exercise price of options by selling the shares acquired on the exercise of these options unless the sale of those shares occurs outside the periods specified in section 5.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Relevant if collar or loan proceeds are intended to fund the exercise price of options via a cashless exercise during a Prohibited Period.

bespoke_clauses.clause: a disposal of Company Securities that is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights ... is excluded from the restrictions outlined in section 5. Please note section 11 ... Restricted Persons must not enter into margin loan agreements or other secured lending arrangements ... without first obtaining prior written clearance.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The bank's enforcement sale on default is not blocked by a Blackout Period, but only because the underlying secured loan was itself cleared in advance under section 11; an uncleared facility would not benefit from this carve-out.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Restricted Persons must not disclose to anyone that an Additional Period is in effect.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Timing certainty for collar execution, roll or close-out for Restricted Persons can be disrupted by an undisclosed Additional Period.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The Company Secretary must report all notifications of trading in, and clearances given, in relation to trading in Company Securities to the next Board meeting of the Company.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The Board will be made aware of any collar or secured-lending clearance granted to a Restricted Person.

summary: A funded OTC collar is achievable for a Restricted Person once the relevant shares have vested: hedging that limits the economic risk of unvested equity-based remuneration is banned outright, but hedging of a vested holding, and the margin loan or other secured lending arrangement financing it, are each expressly permitted with prior written clearance from the appropriate Approving Officer (Managing Director, Chair, or Chair of the Audit Committee, per the section 7 hierarchy), obtained while not in possession of Inside Information and, if within a Prohibited Period, only in exceptional circumstances such as severe financial hardship or a court order. Clearance is valid for 5 business days (or another period the Approving Officer sets), and any dealing under it must be notified to the Company Secretary within 2 business days, with all clearances reported to the Board. Company Securities are defined to expressly include over-the-counter options and other derivatives, so a bank collar falls squarely within scope, and while a secured lender's enforcement sale on default is excluded from the Blackout Period trading ban, the underlying loan itself must first be cleared under section 11. For ordinary (non-restricted) Employees, hedging and secured financing are not addressed by the policy and only need clearance if undertaken during a Prohibited Period or structured as short-term trading, which is separately banned (purchase and sale within 3 months) subject to Board exemption in exceptional circumstances.
